theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_fli_weight_integral_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (θ₀ : ℝ) (W : ℕ → Varifold N n (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5)), (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5 ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(W k).measure) atTop (𝓝 (θ₀ * ∫ z, f z ∂(planeVarifoldMeasure P)))) → ∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) 5 → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ x, g x ∂(W k).weight) atTop (𝓝 (θ₀ * ∫ x in (P.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))))
